subject: About the problem to upload data in methylKit

messages.author: ad3cfb04d1de0e22
messages.subject: About the problem to upload data in methylKit
parts:
Hi

I have some problem to upload my data in R. Now I start to analyze RRBS
data using R.

But I cannnot upload my data in my PC (Windows 7, 64bit). The script
and data work well in other machine (Mac).

I use R x64 2.15.2 and methylKit version 0.5.7. And I confirmed that
test data provided from methylKit worked well.


1) Our script is shown below;

file.list2=list("8227_34neg38negpos_D8_GTGAAA_L008_R1_trimmed.fq.txt_bismark.sam.sorted","8227_34pos38neg_D5_ACAGTG_L008_R1_trimmed.fq.txt_bismark.sam.sorted",
"8227_34neg38posneg_D7_AGTCAA_L008_R1_trimmed.fq.txt_bismark.sam.sorted", "8227_34pos38pos_D6_CTTGTA_L008_R1_trimmed.fq.txt_bismark.sam.sorted")
objs=read.bismark(location=file.list2,
sample.id=list("34neg38neg","34pos38neg", "34neg38pos", "34pos38pos"),
assembly="hg19", save.folder="RRBS", read.context="CpG",
save.context="CpG", mincov=5, treatment=c(1,1,1,1))

2) And error message is below;
Error in .local(location, sample.id, assembly, save.folder,
save.context, :
Error in methylation calling...
Make sure the file is sorted correctly and it is a legitimate Bismark
SAM file

Could someone please help to overcome this situation.

Naoya

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: About the problem to upload data in methylKit
parts:
Hello,

read.bismark() function may not work in windows if there are spaces in directory names where R is installed. I didn't find a fix for that yet as I don't have any capability to debug the function in Windows, we usually use linux or Mac OS X.

If anyone has a fix for this, that would be great to hear.

Best,
Altuna

messages.author: a6b042e69a77fec4
messages.subject: Re: About the problem to upload data in methylKit
parts:
you have to make sure that the sam is well formatted, not modified after being generated by bismark.
We had this problem afetr calling "samtools calmd" to add the MD tag to the bam which seemed to change the order of the tags in the sam file, causing methylKit to fail with the same error

Gérald
